I'm a scooter rider and other than the lack of scooter tricks (bc it's a bmx game) it's a super good game! I like the uniqueness of how you can paint your vehicle and how the transfers and tricks work! I also like the fact the tricks are motion not the click of a button. Anyway recommend but immersive mode is SUPER immersive (I don't get motion sick and I almost threw up) so be wary!

1. A bunch of tricks, most games only have wheelies and whips but this game has soooooo many

2. Good physics, the game is not clanky and the physics compliment the tricks and realism

3. Maps, the maps are crazy big, the beginning one is actually good for beginners, and they got dirt, ramps, bowls, indoor, outdoor, room to freestyle, and races

4. Graphics, I thought the meta graphics would SUCK but its actually one of the best graphic maps on vr

5. Variety, there is maps based for different things dirt map for mtb, indoors for scoot, and freestyle for bmx (Miami map compliments both scoot and bmx

6. Customization, paint is like a entirely different game, characters, and modes

7. Overall 100% worth 15$ and it takes skill which I LOVE
